# On and off by default — the `spell` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#spell).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** every repo, unless `--no-spell`.
- **Rules:** 7 — 0 on, 3 on with `preview = true`, 3 off in an opt-in preset, 1 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `spell/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 3 | 3 warn | known typos in comments, docs, prose strings, Markdown, names, keys and classes |
| `spell/strict` | no — opt in | 6 | 6 warn | spell/recommended plus the dictionary check: every word of prose in a word list, one spelling of each word across the project, and no accepted word that hides a typo |

## Rules

`on` runs in a fresh install; a `preview` rule runs only with `preview = true` ([SR-RULE-PACKS](../../../records/0101_rule-packs.md) decision 9). † a preset `init` writes only when the repo has what it is for.

| Rule | By default | Severity | Preset |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`spell/inconsistent-term`](../spell/inconsistent-term.md) | off — opt-in preset | — | `spell/strict` |
| [`spell/known-typo`](../spell/known-typo.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `spell/recommended`, `spell/strict` |
| [`spell/known-typo-identifier`](../spell/known-typo-identifier.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `spell/recommended`, `spell/strict` |
| [`spell/known-typo-key`](../spell/known-typo-key.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `spell/recommended`, `spell/strict` |
| [`spell/locale-variant`](../spell/locale-variant.md) | off — in no preset | — | — |
| [`spell/suspicious-word`](../spell/suspicious-word.md) | off — opt-in preset | — | `spell/strict` |
| [`spell/unknown-word`](../spell/unknown-word.md) | off — opt-in preset | — | `spell/strict` |
